prs.location:
Kilcullen is situated off the Dublin to Waterford (M9) motorway, between Naas and Kilkenny, and is centred on the crossroads of the R413 and R448 regional roads.

Kilcullen straddles the River Liffey and is about 50 km (31 mi) from Dublin, under 5 km (3 mi) from Newbridge, and also close to Kildare Town and Naas. 

Kilcullen benefits from a primary school and secondary school in the village and there are ample shops, bars & restaurants all in walking distance of Market Square. 

Kilcullen also benefits from a number of other public amenities, including a library, a health centre, and Kilcullen Community Centre which offers top class sports and leisure facilities.

description:
Comer Group Ireland are proud to present this selection of large, modern 1-, 2- & 3-bedroom apartments and duplex apartments at Market Square, Kilcullen, Co. Kildare. All accommodations are fitted out to the highest standard and furnished to include, sofa, coffee table, TV stand, dining table & chairs, fridge/freezer, washer/dryer, oven, hob, microwave, dishwasher, beds & mattresses, bed side cabinets, fitted wardrobes. All broadband and TV providers are available (this is not included in the rent and tenants must arrange supply themselves). Communal bin disposal is included in the monthly rent. One car space in the underground car park included in the monthly rent.
All apartments benefit from a large private balcony. There is also communal rooftop access.

With all amenities nearby including both primary and secondary schools, several large convenience stores and numerous pubs and restaurants, these properties are a must see. 

*No Pets allowed*

NO PHONE CALLS PLEASE.

Enquiries via daft.ie only. Interested parties need to click on the ad for the relevant property within this development page to be able to send an email query. 

Please do not contact either the Comer Group Ireland office or Comer Group UK head office regarding lettings, as these are handled via the lettings department directly. Any queries through the main office will be disregarded.
